mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called glucans; while those consisting of fructose, mannose and xylose alone are referred to as fructans. mannans and xylans, respectively."
Polysaccharides consisting mainly of glucose are called glucans; while those consisting of fructose, mannose and xylose alone are referred to as fructans. mannans and xylans, respectively.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same in all animals: i."
The sequence of event is the same in all animals: i.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a β-ketoacid, and like many such compounds may spontaneously decarboxylate."
Acetoacetate is a β-ketoacid, and like many such compounds may spontaneously decarboxylate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a group of compounds containing carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen (about 16%) and sulphur."
Proteins are a group of compounds containing carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen (about 16%) and sulphur.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the simplest forms of sugars and make up oligosaccharides and the polysaccharides."
The monosaccharides are the simplest forms of sugars and make up oligosaccharides and the polysaccharides.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the purest forms of cellulose."
Natural cotton is one of the purest forms of cellulose.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called α - 1, 4 glycosidic link."
The bond is called α - 1, 4 glycosidic link.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an intermediate resulting from the hydrolysis and digestion of starch as well as the action of heat on starch."
Dextrin is an intermediate resulting from the hydrolysis and digestion of starch as well as the action of heat on starch.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fundamental unit from which all carbohydrates are formed."
The monosaccharide is the fundamental unit from which all carbohydrates are formed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most notable STORAGE SITE of fats in animals."
Adipose tissue is the most notable STORAGE SITE of fats in animals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most important of the simple sugars."
The hexoses and pentoses are the most important of the simple sugars.

helix

liver

resulting GTP

Sucrose
